testcase.name: with no flash unit there is no flash chip, the timer chip comes first and the grid chip second, and the shutter is where it was
at Grid the grid fills the preview and sits under both bands
the status bar is hidden on the Activity's window and shown again when the camera leaves
an unavailable camera says why, and the shutter cannot be used
at Off there is no grid and no level
Back closes the camera and the photos already taken are not withdrawn, and there is no Done control
the camera stays open across several shots and hands up one photo per tap
the fake leaves a partial file on failure, which is what makes the cleanup test able to fail
in portrait all four chips sit inside the strip, Flash, Timer, Grid, Location, none overlapping
opened in portrait, the arrangement follows a window turned to landscape, shutter to the port edge and strip to the punch-hole edge
the running count is the only feedback and it reads as a sentence
a failed capture leaves no file behind
the count label is singular at one and plural either side
the failure message clears on the next successful shot
each shot goes to its own file
at Grid and Level the level is shown and its sensor is released when the camera closes
in portrait the strip is flush with the top edge and the shutter band with the bottom
a real touch anywhere on the flash chip reaches it, over the viewfinder
the Activity's window asks for seamless rotation while the camera is open, and stops on the way out
a failed capture is shown, the count does not move, and nothing is handed up
an unavailable camera can still be dismissed
a camera still opening shows progress rather than a dead viewfinder
outlined overlay text is one text node, not two
the viewfinder is composed once the session opens
the session is opened once on enter and closed once when the dialog leaves
a photo is handed over as it lands, before the camera is dismissed
